Images.Caption: A hooded masked merchant, selling passage on his ship on a foggy dock.
A player in western clothing fishing near a bridge.
A player in western gear, holding a fishing pole and his catch under a bridge near the water.
A ghoul stands over a dead player and looks up at the sky.
A ghoul player dressed in cowboy gear stares at the camera with glowing green eyes while holding a rifle.
A Ghoul swims in red water full of hazardous barrels while two more ghouls in swimsuits watch on the shore next to a large construction tractor.
A closeup of a ghoul wearing headphones and a thick jacket, smiling.
A female player wearing a jumpsuit holds a thumbs up pose. Behind her is a Power Armor suit with Scorchbeast queen helmet.
A dirty metal tiered structure with a plane engine generator is set up in front of a hill.
A small shelter built with tires and stairs is situated below a red bridge with defensive towers.
Concrete and glass structure stands above the Wasteland. String lights spell out "friends welcome".

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Greetings from Fallout 76 – Don't be a Stranger  
From Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4. Join millions of players as you explore, build, quest, and triumph in a massive open-world multiplayer adventure.  
It is Reclamation Day, 2102: Play solo or co-op as your fellow Vault Dwellers emerge from your shelter to reclaim the wilderness of West Virginia 25 years after the Great War tore the world asunder.  

Years of FREE Updates 
Fallout 76 is continually growing, with years of free updates and map expansions, plus an extensive calendar of in-game events. There's always something new to discover as Appalachia evolves. 

Forge your Survivor 
Build the survivor you want using Fallout's iconic S.P.E.C.I.A.L. system. Become a heavily armored Power Armor tank, a stealthy sniper, a gunslinging cowboy, a melee brawler, or create a build that's uniquely your own. 

Build a C.A.M.P.  
Settle the wastes! Choose a location, then design and expand the C.A.M.P. of your dreams. Build anything from a mountainside fortress to a woodland estate, a raider outpost, or a mad scientist lair.  The customization options are vast, it's up to you!  

Discover Stories Across Appalachia 
Embark on rich story quests filled with competing factions and meaningful choices that shape your adventure.  Journey from dense forests to the scorching Burning Springs and the radioactive Cranberry Bog, where every region is filled with unique stories, hidden rewards, and legendary cryptids. Hunt or be hunted by the mysterious Mothman, towering Sheepsquatch, or the legendary Bigfoot that stalks the wilderness. 

The Slasher 
Ritual murder sprees grip Appalachia’s denizens in terror! Join the investigation to find who - or what - is responsible as you (grave)dig up clues, stop cultist Infestations across the Wasteland and go on a brand-new Head Hunt event to uncover the truth behind the return of the notorious Slasher! 

https://eulas.bethesda.net/fallout-76
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Twenty-five years after the bombs fall, you and your fellow Vault Dwellers emerge into post-nuclear America. Join millions of players as you explore, build, quest, and triumph in a massive open-world multiplayer adventure.

LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes: Something sinister is stirring in Appalachia. Follow a trail of murders to prove, or debunk, the return of The Slasher! Solve the mystery over several weeks of activities such as grave digging, cultist Infestations, and a new Head Hunt for the dangerous killer.
